scope: Supply, fabricate, prime, deliver and erect second floor and roof steelwork to Halstead drawings 14017/04, /05, /08.

Second floor (14017/04 rev C): 2No 203x203x71 UKC on grids B and H, 3No 180x90x26 UKPFC, 203x203x46 UKC stair trimmer, 200x90x30 UKPFC at the service riser, 2No 203x102x23 UKB at door head, 4No 100x100x5 SHS galvanised corner posts and 16No 6x50 straps across the PC planks (Detail Z).

Roof (14017/05 rev B, 14017/08 rev B): 2No 203x203x46 UKC A-frames B1 on legs, 2No 152x152x37 UKC B2, 4 pieces of 152x152x30 UKC B3 spliced over the posts (Detail W), 2No 152x152x30 flat B4 welded at the crank to 2No 152x152x23 raking B5 on legs, and 2No 200x100x6.3 RHS posts P1, with the baseplates, cap and end plates of Details W, X, Y and the P1 base (Detail 2).
Erection onto padstones and PC units prepared by others.

provisional.item: Galvanising to 4No 100x100x5 SHS corner posts SP1 and their 8 base/cap plates - about 226 kg at the worst-case 3600 post length (about 50 kg if the posts are 600). To be priced on receipt of the post height and base/cap details (not on the drawings).
P1 baseplate thickness and anchors (Detail 2 on 14017/07, not issued) - priced 350x250x15 with 4No M12 resin anchors each
SP1 corner post length - priced worst case 3600 each (eaves about +600 down one storey); reduces by about 3000 per post (about 175 kg in all) if they stand on the 2nd floor
Connection design calculations and shop drawings for Engineer approval, including the undetailed beam-to-beam joints (B3 into B1, B2 and B4 onto B3) priced here as rule-based fin plates

exclusions: Floors and drawings not issued to us: piling (14017/01), ground floor (02), first floor (03), foundation details (06), superstructure sections and details (07) and balcony details (09) per issue sheet GA01 - any steel on them is excluded until issued.
Lintels generally - by the lintel manufacturer (14017/04 note 'Lintel schedule to be prepared by Lintel Manufacturer').
Padstones (shaped, 440x100x215 concrete, Class B engineering brick), PC hollowcore units, concrete and grout - by others.
Timber, timber trimmers, wall plates and fixings to timber.
Builder's work: pockets, temporary propping, dry packing and making good.
Fire protection; galvanising other than the provisional SP1 item above (not yet priced).
Building Control, Party Wall matters and Engineer's fees.
rfis: Drawing 14017/07 'Superstructure Sections and Details' is referenced (Detail 2 = P1 RHS post base on PC units; Section R = 200x90x30 PFC at the riser) but not issued. Needed for P1 baseplate thickness, anchor spec and SF4 bearing.
Drawings 01, 02, 03, 06 and 09 are on the issue sheet but not issued. A whole-building takeoff needs at least 02, 03, 07 and 09 (lower floors may carry further steel).

Top of steel for the beams carrying the 2nd-floor PC (SF1 203x203x71 on B/H, SF2 180x90x26 PFCs, SF3 stair trimmer, SF4 riser PFC): assumed underside of 200 PC = SSL 65.730 - 200 = 65.530. Confirm, and whether bearing pads/plates are needed.
